dedupe_keys.name: christchurch central recovery plan blueprint spatial masterplan for the post earthquake rebuild

description: The Blueprint for the Christchurch Central Recovery Plan set the spatial framework for redeveloping the city centre after the Canterbury earthquakes. According to the consultancy's project page, the Canterbury Earthquake Recovery Authority competitively tendered a spatial masterplan to give certainty for investment and the rebuild, building on Christchurch City Council's earlier plan and its extensive public engagement; the identified anchor projects were meant to give confidence for reinvestment and catalyse recovery. Boffa Miskell, a landscape architecture consultancy based in Christchurch, led the work, which it describes as a milestone for its profession. Coverage: central Christchurch. Access: the project page; the Blueprint itself is a government planning document. Licence: not stated. Caveats: the page is the consultancy's own account and does not evaluate how the plan performed. Simulation uses: a reference for staged public-space and anchor-project reconstruction in post-disaster urban recovery models. Related records: the Christchurch post-earthquake placemaking case.
